vpc-network.scope: Follow two independently verified HTTPS hops and use separate proxy and origin connection records.
vpc-network.observation: The entry TLS session was valid in all four requests. Two entry connections reused one origin connection. The wrong origin name returned 502 before the origin received HTTP.

operator-profiling.scope: Run the real Triton tail-mask kernel with an independent numerical oracle and a zero-padding counterexample.
operator-profiling.observation: The Linux Triton CPU interpreter preserved inactive writes in both paths. Padding with zero distorted the valid probability mass on partial blocks. Physical GPU correctness and performance remain pending.

agent-observability.scope: Use the real MCP and OpenTelemetry SDKs across process restarts to distinguish parent propagation, span links and committed effects.
agent-observability.observation: Three traces and attempts produced one receipt and one committed report. A new root linked to the original root while HTTP receive spans remained children of the current send spans.
